description:
Associate, Product Engineer (Working Student - 12 months) 

 Scandit TAMPERE 

 Imagine the what. Build the how.
 Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication, or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows. It provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us as we continue to expand, grow, innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.

 Your opportunity 

 As a Product Engineering Assistant (working student) at Scandit, you will join our product squad and help build the data foundation behind our computer vision products. You will work closely with our Product Engineering team and the wider engineering organization, and see how your work feeds directly into product development.

 Our Approach To Work 

 This is an on-site role, one day per week, not hybrid. You will work from our Tampere office on a fixed weekday that we agree on together around your semester schedule, so you need to live within commuting distance of Tampere.

 What You Will Do 

 You will build and maintain synthetic data templates and datasets, and test both their technical performance and their quality. You will also improve our Python-based tooling and bring in the latest AI features for dataset generation, validation and evaluation. Much of the work is hands-on and repeatable by nature: generating, checking, and refining data until it meets a precise standard.

 
 Maintain and expand the data foundation our product teams rely on

 Generate synthetic datasets that reproduce challenging real-world computer vision conditions (low light, glare, motion blur, damaged labels)

 Use and extend Python tooling to automatically generate, annotate, and validate datasets

 Test dataset quality and technical performance, and share clear findings with the team

 Follow new AI methods for data generation and evaluation, and suggest where they could improve our work

 
 Who You Are 

 You study computer science, engineering or a related field, and you enjoy precise, structured work where the result has to be right. You are comfortable with tasks that repeat, because you care about getting the details right every time.

 
 Currently enrolled in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (for example at TAU or TAMK)

 Based in Tampere and available on-site one fixed weekday per week

 Comfortable scripting in Python and using AI coding tools

 Strong attention to detail and a structured way of working

 Good written and spoken English

 Able to commit to the role for at least 12 months

 Eligible to work in Finland
